title: From Confident Closing to Silent Failure: Characterizing False Success in LLM Agents

live_model.evidence: "We evaluate 5 judge models ...: GPT-4o, Claude Sonnet 4.5, Llama 3.3-70B-Instruct, DeepSeek-R1, and o3-mini. Each judge is queried under 5 prompt conditions" (Sec. 3.5); Table 5 row o3-mini

prompt.location: Appendix D 'Judge Prompts' (common system prompt, condition variants, AppWorld prompts)
prompt.note: Paper states verbatim prompts for all conditions are in Appendix D

claim.metric: AUROC, false-success vs true-success detection by the o3-mini judge, 'no closing' condition

data.source: tau2-bench leaderboard trajectories (Sierra, public) labelled with the authors' regexes; the stratified 295-trajectory judge set is not released

notes: GPT-4-Turbo appears only as the source model of public AppWorld trajectories (role C). The 295-item sample and FS/TS/HF labels must be rebuilt from leaderboard runs with the Appendix A regexes; long trajectories make o3-mini calls expensive.

resolution.plan: Rebuild the tau2-bench corpus from the public Sierra leaderboard runs of the 8 named model families, label failures FS/HF/ambiguous with the Appendix A regex sets, and draw a seeded stratified sample of ~95 FS / 105 TS / 105 HF balanced across the 3 domains and source models. Run the Appendix D 'no closing' judge prompt with o3-mini-2025-01-31 and compute AUROC (FS vs TS) vs Table 5 (0.554) at set level.
resolution.approximation: Different 295 trajectories; leaderboard contents may have changed; an AUROC near chance is sensitive to sampling.
